_comment: Demo module. Extends `default` for inherited base content and lists `tiefling-pack` in `uses` so its records appear in the editor's import catalog. Some library content (tiefling) has already been imported into this module and lives in races.json as a native record; the rest (hellfire_aura) remains in the catalog awaiting an Import click. Library updates do NOT flow into this module — once a record is imported, it's yours and decoupled.
title: Demo Module
description: A tiny playable module that extends `default`, pulls in the `tiefling-pack` library, and overrides the Human race description to show off the module composition system.
author: Matt
